title: Observability weekly notes - 2026-07-13
content:
Summary
Week of 2026-07-13. Focus areas: tracing sampling fixes, Grafana dashboard refresh for cost telemetry, and alert tuning for tail latency increases on hosted-api routes. Weekly sync with Platform to finalize metrics contract for Dedicated and Private deployments.

Standup highlights (selected)
- Mon 2026-07-13: Noticed higher p99 latency for /v1/generate on hosted-api (US-W). Traces show spike correlated with increased cache evictions on the KV cache layer. Initial mitigation: increase cache TTL for short lived prefixes and roll out improved eviction metrics.
- Tue 2026-07-14: Deployed provisional sampler change (trace sampling ratio from 1% -> 5% for error and p95+p99 buckets) to increase signal for tail events. Observed better visibility; still need to reduce noise in low-cost routes.
- Wed 2026-07-15: Dashboard refresh landed (PR #128) adding per-route cost breakdown panels and an aggregated model token-cost heatmap. Early feedback from SRE: charts are useful but need better time-range defaults.
- Thu 2026-07-16: Cost telemetry sizing - ran a quick cost model for caching + batching improvements; estimated potential savings of ~18% on token spend for interactive routes if suggested batching policy is applied.
- Fri 2026-07-17: Weekly platform sync. Agreed on metrics contract: standardize latency buckets (p50/p90/p95/p99), unique request_id instrumentation, and model-version label semantics for Dedicated deployments.

Tracing and sampling
- Root cause for p99 spike: KV cache thrashing caused by a small number of high-variance prompts that frequently update prefix keys. Traces show most added latency in token-generation loop where KV lookups miss.
- Actions taken: bumped KV cache TTL to 15s for short-prefix namespace (hot-prefixes), implemented a lightweight LRU eviction instrumentation to surface eviction counts to traces, and increased error/p95 sampling to 5% (see linked PR).
- Next: implement a small adaptive sampler that increases sampling for request_ids that show elevated latency within a short window (owner: Ravi). Target delivery: 2026-07-27.

Dashboards / Observability UX
- New panels added: per-route token-cost, model-version cost trend, batching efficiency panel (tokens-per-request vs latency), and a dedicated cost-alerts dashboard.
- UX items: default time window currently set to 1h; SRE recommends 6h for cost panels and 24h for trend views. TODO to update panel defaults (owner: Jordan).
- Migrations: consolidated three legacy dashboards into "observability/service-overview". Left lightweight aliases for teams depending on older URLs.

Cost telemetry and economics
- Telemetry improvements landed this week provide better mapping between tokens consumed and billing events (experimental). This allows near-real-time cost attribution by route/model.
- Initial analysis (sample week): hosted-api /chat endpoints account for ~62% of token spend, with 12% attributed to repeated retries (client-side). Recommendations: expose a per-route retry metric to customers and add a best-practice doc in Console (owner: Priya).
- Quick wins: enable prefix caching for high-frequency short prompts (expected 7-10% immediate savings), and rollout suggested batching policy for medium-latency interactive routes.

Alerts and SLOs
- Adjusted alerts this week: raised threshold for p99 latency alert for background-batched routes to avoid noisy paging during autoscaling. Tuned alert to only fire if p99 > 750ms for 10m window and error-rate > 0.5%.
- SLO review: consolidated SLOs across hosted/dedicated for latency; added an annotation to explain differences in tail expectations for Dedicated (higher throughput, different p99 baseline).

Incidents and postmortem notes
- Incident OBS-342 (2026-07-12 p99 spike): partial mitigations applied. Postmortem draft in progress - focus on cache TTL defaults, insufficient trace sampling for tail events, and a missing dashboard for KV eviction rates.

Work in progress / PRs
- PR #128: dashboard refresh (merged) - owner Jordan.
- PR #130: LRU eviction metrics for KV cache (in_review) - owner Ravi.
- PR #131: adaptive trace sampler prototype (draft) - owner Ravi.
- PR #133: cost attribution mapping for token events (in_review) - owner Priya.

Blocked / help needed
- Need infra assistance to increase retention for high-cardinality trace attributes for 14 days for a small tenant set (request raised to Platform: PLAT-789).
- Product: need guidance on naming conventions for model-version labels to ensure metrics join safely across regions. Meeting scheduled next Tues with Product-hosted-api.

Action items and owners
- Ravi: finish LRU eviction metrics and PR review (target 2026-07-20).
- Jordan: update dashboard time-range defaults and annotate changes in the changelog (target 2026-07-22).
- Priya: draft Console best-practice note on retries and add per-route retry metrics to telemetry backlog (target 2026-07-24).
- Alyssa: finalize postmortem for OBS-342 and create follow-up tickets for TTL defaults (target 2026-07-21).

Meetings scheduled
- Platform metrics contract follow-up - 2026-07-20 10:00 PT (Alyssa, Ravi, Jordan, Platform owners).
- Dashboard walk-through with SRE - 2026-07-21 16:00 PT (open invite).

Notes to self / rough ideas
- Consider adding an "anomaly score" on traces derived from a rolling baseline; could drive adaptive sampling and alerting.
- Explore a low-cost aggregated trace histogram for p99 contributors (approximation to reduce cardinality).

Appendix: useful links
- Dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/128
- Incident: OBS-342
- Platform ticket: PLAT-789
- Tracing playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Tracing+Playbook

End of weekly notes
